facts.claim: Carnival Encounter (Carnival Cruise Line): Entered service 2002; 108,977 GT; 2600 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Grand class.
Carnival Encounter is a Grand-class cruise ship operated by Carnival Cruise Line.
Following a renovation and a renaming to Pacific Encounter, she debuted in August 2022 upon P&O's staged resumption of operations.
As of March 2025, she has been transferred to Carnival Cruise Line under the name Carnival Encounter and will be sailing from Brisbane.

catalogSpecs.description: Formerly Star Princess, then Pacific Encounter (P&O Australia). Rebranded Carnival Encounter in March 2025. Homeported in Brisbane.
